lines.zh: 三格高的身子，走一步压一步。
lines.en: Three blocks tall, and each step weighs down.

lines.zh: 我这副身子走得实在很慢。
lines.en: This body of mine moves very slowly.

lines.zh: 四十点护甲挂在我身上。
lines.en: Forty points of armor hang on me.
Every step feels like moving stone.
I walk along the base of the wall.
My shoulders brush both walls.
My shoulder scrapes the ceiling.
I am in no hurry; hurrying gains nothing.
Something creaks underfoot.

lines.zh: 四十点护甲，走得像慢钟。
lines.en: Forty armor, moving like a slow clock.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，像在量地。
lines.en: I move step by step, as if measuring.
This body is heavier than before.
I have stood here a long while.
Nobody has come to trouble me.

lines.zh: 我望着远处那一线灰光。
lines.en: I watch that line of grey light far off.

lines.zh: 我的手臂垂下来，几乎到地。
lines.en: My arms hang almost to the ground.
The wind passes through me.
It stops on its own.
I rest a hand on the wall's edge.
The wall cracks a little under it.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼看了看低垂的天。
lines.en: I raise my eyes to the low sky.
I stand taller than the doorway.

lines.zh: 我这一身厚甲，得用合金刀。
lines.en: Against this armor, bring an alloy blade.
I have not shifted at all.
You are much smaller than I am.
I will not strike first.
Unless you strike first.
You may pass.
You have not drawn a weapon.
You standing like that is good.
This iron shell of mine is forty thick.

lines.zh: 你的鞋踩到了我的影子。
lines.en: Your shoes are on my shadow.
I have not given half a step.
That was filtered through forty points.
Your hand hurts more than my armor.
A shallow dent marks my armor.
I hold still for a moment.
A shallow mark is left on the plate.

lines.zh: 这点力度，像被风推了一下。
lines.en: That force felt like a gust.
Does your hand hurt?
I turn around slowly.
You are still there.
That bundle in your hand.
It smells like something to eat.
Hand that over.
I cannot come that quickly.
Just set it on the ground.
And I will pretend I did not see you.

lines.zh: 你举着的食物我都看清了。
lines.en: I see clearly the food you hold up.
Your arm will ache first.
Better to set it down.
I will come over slowly.
You ran headlong into my leg.
I halt and glance at you.
You did not knock yourself over?
I give a little room on my side.
Mind my feet.

lines.zh: 我抬起来的时候看不见下面。
lines.en: I cannot see below when I lift one.
Shift two steps aside.
Now there is room to walk.

lines.zh: 你从我手肘下面钻过去。
lines.en: You duck under my elbow.
I hold my arm up for you.
My size does not suit that.

lines.zh: 我连自己的事都管不好。
lines.en: I cannot even manage my own affairs.
Go ask something with flesh.
You think, looking at me.
Do you think that fits?
I think it does not fit either.

lines.zh: 这身甲连自己都护不全。
lines.en: This armor cannot even cover me fully.
This talk ends here.
Let us leave it there.

lines.zh: 你要真想知道，答案是不行。
lines.en: If you really want to know, the answer is no.
That thing in the tile gap.
I bend my knees and lower myself.
I crouch slower than I talk.

lines.zh: 那东西在我掌里像粒沙。
lines.en: It sits in my palm like a grain of sand.
I put it back where it was.
I crouch and rise again.
My knees creak on the way down.
It still lies on the flagstones.
I did not touch it.
I shift it to the base of the wall.
Your hand reached out first.
Then I will stop being polite.

lines.zh: 四十点甲的我，被食物引出来。
lines.en: Forty points of armor, lured out by food.
Forty points of armor; you will not break it.
Your hands are shaking badly.
Then stop fighting.

lines.zh: 你的手先伸过来，别怪我。
lines.en: You reached out first; do not blame me.
It is not too late to stop.
I wait for you to pull back.
You finally stopped.
This is quite good.
You are half a pace off.
There, that is right.
Neither of us needs to be hurt.
You are still standing.
You are looking at me; I understand.
I stand and watch you circle.
You have circled me three times.

lines.zh: 我这副身子走得很慢很实在。
lines.en: This body of mine walks slow and solid.
You will not find a gap.
There is no gap to find on me.
You stop and gulp for air.
I stand before you and do not back away.
Your strength will run out.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把重心移向前脚。
lines.en: I slowly shift my weight to my front foot.
This armor is not for hitting people.
It is made for taking blows.
You have struck many times.
I am only counting the blows.
Your knuckles are worn raw.
Wherever you hide, I shift that way.
Do you still want to go on?
I do not wish to hit back.
But one step closer.

lines.zh: 我就不客气了，四十点护甲不是摆设。
lines.en: Then I will not hold back; forty armor is no decoration.
You finally gave half a step.
I lift an arm and block.
I did not hit back.
That is enough; you may go.
I merely pushed you once.
Only to move you away.
Forty armor; you can't dent me.
My movements are slow.
That one you can dodge.
So this is not a fight.
This is only shooing you off.
I push you back one step.
I did not really strike you.
Are you steady on your feet.
That should be enough.

lines.zh: 我的拳头只用了三分力。
lines.en: I put only a third of my strength into the blow.
In a fight I am too slow.
You are more stubborn than I thought.
One more shove, still nothing.
I eased off on that one.
You finally stepped back.
I stand here, and have waited long.
Someone comes from the far end.
I did not know you before.
Then I will watch first.
You go your way.
I go mine.
There is not much to see here.
I stoop low and walk in from above.
The wind blows from one end to the other.
My armor did not rattle.
The sky here hangs lower than elsewhere.
I turn and the armor clatters.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，热得不舒服。
lines.en: Fire heats my armor, unpleasantly hot.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，地面塌了一块。
lines.en: I fall and the ground collapses.

lines.zh: 水没过胸口，我站着不动。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest; I stand still.
The blast shifts me half a step.

lines.zh: 一支箭撞在甲上，落下来。
lines.en: An arrow strikes the plate and drops away.
That spell leaves me numb.
Being slow does not mean I am not hungry.

lines.zh: 雷进不了这层甲，只到我表面。
lines.en: Lightning will not pass this plate; it only reaches the surface.
The flagstones beneath me vanish.
